params.caption: 🕹️ Ex-Tekken director Harada criticises Xbox Series S in front of Xbox staff Katsuhiro Harada, former director of the Tekken series, said at a developer panel that he wished hardware like the Xbox Series S had never been released. He made the remark while a member of the Xbox team was in the room, reviving the debate over the weaker console holding back development. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 17:09 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #Xbox #Tekken #GamingNews
